name: Demand
text: Holds the need or the duty to protect people: governments and public agencies, employers, and organisations of the workers and communities affected.

name: Supply
text: Provides what protection needs: technology, services and delivery on the ground, insurance, lending and grants, research and data.

name: Platform
text: Connects demand and supply: networks, alliances and conveners, and the bodies that set shared rules or standards for a market.
